same_names_elsewhere.note: On the west side of Reading, a stub labelled '...WAY' (probably Ridgeway's west part) is cut by the plate edge.

reads.note: Same place as t02_69. RIDGEWAY meets the east side of READING at a T. Ridgeway's west part leaves Reading about 180 px SW of this point.

Ridgeway (printed RIDGEWAY) runs from the east and bends at about (740, 5040). It then runs as a narrow street (about 45 px) WNW to meet Reading (printed READING, broad, with a car track) on its east side, by a hydrant at about (490, 4950). I extended Ridgeway's centreline to Reading's centreline, which is near the track (x about 405 at y 5000); Reading's west part is close to the plate edge. Nothing comes in from the west side opposite.
